gpu_policy: one cell at a time, no parallel seeds; no automatic outcome-dependent search expansion
stopping: all manifest cells completed or explicitly failed; no thresholds selected to favor TRACE
exclusion: CLIPArTT passed the two-image compatibility smoke; failures on larger cells remain explicit, never numeric substitutes
limitations: Historical calibration choices cannot be made label-free retroactively. Uniform protocol is a new sensitivity analysis, not untouched deployment confirmation.
